<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/claims">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_ClaimHandling" name="Claim handling" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_ClaimHandling">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_ClaimsOfficer" name="Claims officer">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_ClaimRegistered</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ExamineClaim</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_WriteRecommendation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_SeniorClaimsOfficer" name="Senior claims officer">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CheckRecommendation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ClaimOK</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_ClaimHandlingProceeds</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_ClaimRegistered" name="Claim registered">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RegisteredToExamine</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ExamineClaim" name="Examine claim">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RegisteredToExamine</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ExamineToWrite</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_WriteRecommendation" name="Write settlement recommendation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ExamineToWrite</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NotOKToWrite</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_WriteToCheck</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckRecommendation" name="Check settlement recommendation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_WriteToCheck</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CheckToDecision</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ClaimOK" name="Claim marked OK?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CheckToDecision</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NotOKToWrite</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_OKToProceed</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ClaimHandlingProceeds" name="Claim handling proceeds">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_OKToProceed</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RegisteredToExamine" sourceRef="StartEvent_ClaimRegistered" targetRef="Task_ExamineClaim"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ExamineToWrite" sourceRef="Task_ExamineClaim" targetRef="Task_WriteRecommendation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_WriteToCheck" sourceRef="Task_WriteRecommendation" targetRef="Task_CheckRecommendation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckToDecision" sourceRef="Task_CheckRecommendation" targetRef="Gateway_ClaimOK"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotOKToWrite" name="Not OK" sourceRef="Gateway_ClaimOK" targetRef="Task_WriteRecommendation">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">claim is marked Not OK</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OKToProceed" name="OK" sourceRef="Gateway_ClaimOK" targetRef="EndEvent_ClaimHandlingProceeds">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">claim is marked OK</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

rules.instruction: When the description states that a participant checks whether a completion condition has been met before the process can proceed: Model the check as a distinct activity performed by that participant, followed by a decision gateway whose condition routes the flow back to the relevant earlier steps or onward when the condition is met.
rules.situation: the description specifies that a review determines whether earlier work is acceptable

rules.instruction: When the description names an activity or outcome with multiple stated actions, alternatives, or a distinguishing object or participant.: Label the corresponding BPMN activity or event so its described scope remains identifiable. Preserve materially stated actions, alternatives, and objects or participants; do not substitute a broader or different action or add unsupported details.
rules.situation: the description distinguishes activities by their actions or outcomes

rules.instruction: When the description states a specific activity, decision, or outcome: Label the corresponding BPMN element with wording that preserves the described action and its object or result; do not substitute a related but different action or outcome.
rules.situation: the description states a specific activity or outcome

rules.instruction: When the description says that feedback from reviews may prompt repeated changes to a proposed outcome.: Model feedback handling as a distinct activity, then use a decision point to route the flow through the relevant change and review work again when needed, or onward when no further change is needed.
rules.situation: the description says a review can produce an unfavorable outcome that requires earlier work to be redone and reviewed again, while a favorable outcome allows the process to continue

rules.instruction: When the description lists multiple distinct actions to be performed in sequence, including actions within one process stage: Model each distinct action as a separate BPMN activity and connect the activities in the described order; do not omit an action because it appears in a list.
rules.situation: the description presents two distinct actions as occurring in sequence
